items.reason: Holds the served json file json/capital-markets/views.json of the portal bucket, the CMA views object named by the cma.02.views artifact of channel capital_markets (serve-with-caveat, opal-internal). No silver_datasets or portal_datasets row describes this object, so this row describes it, and opal_describe reads its latest value from it.

The tool answers from the one runtime catalog and reads each servable channel artifact by its key. The silver_datasets and portal_datasets rows already describe every such object except the CMA views object, which the new row json_capital_markets_views describes, so no further row is needed for this tool.
